# Purpose

Award credit for a physically consistent interpretation of the loading, correct torsional boundary conditions, the linear internal-torque function, polar moment, twist integration, maximum stress, parameter sensitivity, and a bounded engineering recommendation.

# Scope of the Base Problem

The base model assumes a uniform solid circular shaft, homogeneous isotropic linear elasticity, Saint-Venant torsion, small twist, constant shear modulus and diameter, ideal torque-free journal bearings, and a perfectly fixed section C. A complete turbine-rotor assessment also requires bending, dynamics, vibration, fatigue, stress concentrations, thermal gradients, bearings, blade attachment behavior, and project-specific limits.

# Supplemental Assessment Structure

- context interpretation and idealization: 25%;
- boundary conditions and internal torque function: 25%;
- twist integration and stress calculation: 30%;
- sensitivity and engineering recommendation: 20%.
